title: DreamHMR: From Video Generation to Human Motion Modeling via Structural Focusing
title_zh: DreamHMR：从视频生成到通过结构聚焦实现人类运动建模

paragraphs.en: Human mesh recovery (HMR) provides a geometric foundation for understanding human motion, but accurately reconstructing both body motion and fine hand articulation from videos remains challenging, especially in real-world scenes where occlusion and partial visibility are common. Video generation pretraining offers rich spatial and temporal priors for this task, but its focus on visual synthesis leaves a gap between these representations and explicit human geometry. We present DreamHMR, a general framework that adapts video generation priors for complete body-and-hand reconstruction. It follows a global-to-local strategy, first grounding video representations in human geometry and then refining body and hand detail with reliable local evidence. Global Body Representation Transfer trains the video backbone to predict complete human renderings, turning its native prediction task into a means of learning surface correspondence and posed geometry. Local Joint Feature Enhancement combines contextual estimates with reliable local evidence to recover fine body and hand detail, while limiting interference from occluders and background. Experiments on five datasets with four video backbones demonstrate strong reconstruction performance across backbone families. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our best model outperforms the best existing methods on all reported metrics of 3DPW, EMDB-1, and RICH, reducing body MPJPE by 4.2%, 4.7%, and 6.1%, respectively. In more challenging occlusion settings on held-out BEDLAM and EgoBody sequences, DreamHMR reduces overall body and hand MPJPE by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively. Our code will be made publicly available.
paragraphs.zh: 人类网格恢复（HMR）为理解人类运动提供了几何基础，但从视频中准确重建身体运动和精细的手部关节活动仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在遮挡和局部可见性常见的真实世界场景中。 视频生成预训练为该任务提供了丰富的空间和时间先验知识，但其对视觉合成的关注使得这些表示与明确的人类几何结构之间存在差距。 我们提出了 DreamHMR，一个通用框架，可将视频生成先验知识应用于完整的身体和手部重建。 该框架遵循从全局到局部的策略：首先将视频表示与人类几何结构建立关联，然后利用可靠的局部证据细化身体和手部的细节。 全局身体表示迁移训练视频主干网络以预测完整的人类渲染图像，将其固有的预测任务转化为学习表面对应关系和姿态几何的方法。 局部关节特征增强将上下文估计与可靠的局部证据相结合，以恢复精细的身体和手部细节，同时限制遮挡物和背景的干扰。 在五个数据集上使用四种视频主干网络进行的实验表明，该框架在不同类型的主干网络上均表现出强大的重建性能。 在统一的评估协议下，我们的最佳模型在 3DPW、EMDB-1 和 RICH 所有已报告的指标上均优于现有的最佳方法，分别将身体 MPJPE 降低了 4.2%、4.7% 和 6.1%。 在保留的 BEDLAM 和 EgoBody 序列更具挑战性的遮挡设置中，DreamHMR 分别将整体身体和手部的 MPJPE 降低了 7.0% 和 10.0%。 我们的代码将被公开提供。

paragraphs.en: Human mesh recovery (HMR) reconstructs the 3D human body from visual observations, providing a geometric foundation for understanding and modeling human motion. Its estimates support a wide range of downstream applications, from structured motion analysis for action recognition ( Goel et al., 2023 ) to motion references for humanoid robot teleoperation and imitation learning ( He et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . The field has advanced rapidly, with progress in monocular parametric body estimation ( Kanazawa et al., 2018 ; Kolotouros et al., 2019 ) , temporal modeling from video ( Kocabas et al., 2020 ) , and large-scale learning from diverse imagery ( Goel et al., 2023 ) . Despite these advances, recovering complete body and hand motion from real-world videos remains challenging, as occlusion and partial visibility leave incomplete and uneven visual evidence across body parts and frames.
paragraphs.zh: 人类网格恢复（HMR）通过视觉观察重建三维人体，为理解与建模人类运动提供了几何基础。 其估计结果支持多种下游应用，从用于动作识别的结构化运动分析（Goel et al., 2023），到为人形机器人远程操作和模仿学习提供运动参考（He et al., 2024; Fu et al., 2025; Zhao et al., 2025; Luo et al., 2026）。 该领域发展迅速，在单目参数化人体估计（Kanazawa et al., 2018; Kolotouros et al., 2019）、基于视频的时序建模（Kocabas et al., 2020）以及从多样化图像进行大规模学习（Goel et al., 2023）等方面取得了进展。 尽管取得了这些进步，但从真实世界视频中恢复完整的人体与手部运动仍然充满挑战，因为遮挡和局部可见性导致不同身体部位和帧之间的视觉证据不完整且不均匀。

paragraphs.en: Recovering motion from such observations requires both inferring missing structure and identifying reliable local evidence. Information from visible body parts and neighboring frames can help constrain unobserved body and hand configurations. However, local features sampled near a joint may correspond to an occluder or the background rather than the target person, so incorporating them indiscriminately can introduce misleading cues. A reconstruction model therefore needs to combine contextual inference of the complete body with selective use of local observations for detailed body and hand recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 从这类观察中恢复动作，既需要推断缺失的结构，也需要识别可靠的局部证据。 可见身体部位和相邻帧中的信息有助于约束未观察到的身体和手部构型。 然而，在关节附近采样的局部特征可能对应于遮挡物或背景，而非目标人物，因此不加区分地引入这些特征可能会带来误导性线索。 因此，重建模型需要将完整身体的上下文推断与局部观察的选择性使用相结合，以实现对身体和手部的详细恢复。

paragraphs.en: Video generation pretraining offers a promising starting point for learning such contextual representations ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ) . By learning to synthesize videos, these models capture spatial appearance and temporal dependencies within a shared representation, offering potentially useful cues for reasoning about body and hand motion under partial observations. However, their training objective targets visual synthesis rather than explicit human pose and surface geometry. Transferring these representations to human reconstruction therefore requires adapting them to the underlying structure of the human body.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成预训练为学习此类上下文表示提供了一个有希望的起点（Team Wan 等人，2025）。 通过学习合成视频，这些模型能够在共享表示中捕捉空间外观和时间依赖关系，从而可能为在部分观察条件下推理身体和手部运动提供有用的线索。 然而，它们的训练目标侧重于视觉合成，而非明确的人类姿态和表面几何结构。 因此，要将这些表示迁移到人类重建任务中，就需要将其适应于人体的底层结构。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we present DreamHMR, a framework that adapts video generation representations for complete body-and-hand reconstruction through geometric supervision and evidence-gated local refinement. First, Global Body Representation Transfer trains the video backbone to predict renderings of complete SMPL-X bodies ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) , turning its video prediction objective into a proxy for learning human structure. Canonical surface colors encode correspondence across poses, while shading conveys pose-dependent geometry, providing supervision for body regions even when they are absent from the observations. Second, Local Joint Feature Enhancement refines contextual body and hand estimates using features sampled around predicted joints. Supervised evidence scores predict target-person support at these locations and weight the local updates, limiting the influence of features drawn from occluders or background.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了 DreamHMR——一个通过几何监督与证据门控局部优化，将视频生成表示适配于完整身体和手部重建的框架。 首先，全局身体表示迁移会训练视频主干网络预测完整的 SMPL-X 身体渲染（Pavlakos 等人，2019），从而将其视频预测目标转化为学习人体结构的代理任务。 标准表面颜色编码了不同姿态下的对应关系，而阴影则传递了与姿态相关的几何信息，即便观察数据中缺少某些身体区域，也能为其提供监督信号。 其次，局部关节特征增强利用在预测关节周围采样的特征，对上下文中的身体和手部估计进行优化。 受监督的证据分数会预测这些位置处目标人物的支持程度，并对局部更新进行加权，从而限制来自遮挡物或背景的特征所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: DreamHMR makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: DreamHMR 做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We bring pretrained video generation priors to complete body-and-hand reconstruction through Global Body Representation Transfer , offering a new approach to recovering human motion from occluded and incomplete observations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过全局身体表示迁移（Global Body Representation Transfer）将预训练的视频生成先验知识引入到身体与手部的完整重建中，为从被遮挡或不完整的观测数据中恢复人类动作提供了一种新方法。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Local Joint Feature Enhancement to recover fine body and hand detail from reliable local evidence, complementing global reconstruction within a general framework applicable across different video backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了局部联合特征增强方法，通过可靠的局部证据恢复精细的身体和手部细节，从而补充全局重建过程，并适用于不同视频主干网络的一般性框架。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments on five datasets and four video backbones demonstrate that DreamHMR outperforms the best existing methods on standard HMR benchmarks, with body and hand MPJPE reduced by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively, in challenging occlusion settings.
paragraphs.zh: 在五个数据集和四种视频骨干网络上进行的广泛实验表明，DreamHMR 在标准 HMR 基准测试中的表现优于现有的最佳方法，在具有挑战性的遮挡设置下，身体和手部的 MPJPE 分别降低了 7.0% 和 10.0%。

paragraphs.en: Human mesh recovery estimates parametric bodies from images ( Kanazawa et al., 2018 ; Kolotouros et al., 2019 ) , with video models adding temporal context ( Kocabas et al., 2020 ; Goel et al., 2023 ) . PromptHMR-Vid combines full-image features with a box-prompted temporal transformer ( Wang et al., 2025 ) ; GENMO learns a motion distribution for generation and estimation ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Whole-body methods recover articulated bodies and hands ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ; Lin et al., 2023b ; Li et al., 2023 ; Baradel et al., 2024 ; Moon, 2026 ) , scale training data and model capacity ( Cai et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) ; dedicated models recover detailed hand meshes ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Potamias et al., 2025 ) . DreamHMR uses a shared video generation representation for body-and-hand recovery.

paragraphs.en: Image diffusion features support correspondence estimation ( Tang et al., 2023 ; Stracke et al., 2025 ) , while video diffusion features support motion and geometry tasks ( Vélez et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . DPMesh conditions a text-to-image diffusion backbone on 2D observations for occluded mesh recovery ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) , and ADHMR optimizes diffusion-based mesh predictions with preference data ( Shen et al., 2025 ) . DreamHMR adapts video generation features with complete human renderings to encode surface correspondence and posed geometry for body-and-hand recovery.

paragraphs.en: Occluded HMR addresses body reconstruction with incomplete observations ( Khirodkar et al., 2022 ) . PARE aggregates neighboring regions with part-guided attention ( Kocabas et al., 2021 ) , and Divide and Fuse merges part meshes from partially visible images ( Luan et al., 2024 ) . Human and joint tokens structure decoding ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , while local image-aligned features refine hands ( Potamias et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: The canonical surface map is computed once: vertex i i retains 𝐂 i \mathbf{C}_{i} as pose and shape deform the mesh. The rendered color therefore identifies the same body surface location across poses, people, and frames, supplying dense correspondence supervision. As the body moves, its projected location can change while the underlying canonical color assigned to that surface point remains the same.

Their product combines stable surface correspondence with pose-dependent geometry. Rasterization projects the triangles onto the image, resolves visibility, and evaluates this appearance at covered pixels. Compositing with the source RGB yields the three-channel target I t rend I_{t}^{\rm rend} ; repeating the process across frames produces the supervision video. paragraphs.en: We compare PromptHMR-Vid ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , GENMO ( Li et al., 2025 ) , SMPLest-X ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , 3DB-DINOv3 ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and Hand4Whole++ ( Moon, 2026 ) , and instantiate DreamHMR with Cosmos-2B ( NVIDIA and others, 2025 ) , LTX-2B ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ) , Wan-1.3B, and Wan-5B ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ) . Methods share observed RGB and target tracks; video methods use full windows, while image methods use track crops without temporal smoothing. paragraphs.en: Both evidence-based weighting and evidence supervision improve local updates. With evidence supervision, gating reduces occlusion body/hand MPJPE from 113.1/59.6 to 106.3/57.8 mm. With gating, adding evidence supervision (Equation 8 ) reduces errors from 110.7/59.0 to 106.3/57.8 mm. The supervised, ungated variant trains the evidence head as an auxiliary task without using its scores for local updates; gating without evidence supervision sets λ support = 0 \lambda_{\rm support}=0 (Equation 10 ), learning weights through reconstruction gradients. These two variants distinguish learning an evidence predictor as an auxiliary task from using its predictions to weight the local corrections. The full model combines both mechanisms, weighting local features with predicted evidence scores and supervising those scores with binary evidence labels. The full model also achieves the lowest Full-input errors, with larger gains under occlusion.

paragraphs.en: DreamHMR uses cross-frame RGB context to improve reconstruction. Table 5 evaluates the full-budget Wan-1.3B checkpoint at the same center frames after replacing every RGB frame and observation mask with the center-frame input. This intervention increases body/hand MPJPE by 12.71/9.27 mm under occlusion, compared with 3.26/3.58 mm without additional masking. The larger effect under occlusion supports the use of neighboring observations for reconstruction. This diagnostic measures the response to an inference-time change in temporal context and input distribution. The original tracks and timestamps are retained in both conditions, so the repeated sequence removes changing RGB evidence while preserving the tracking input. We score only the center frame to keep the evaluation target fixed across conditions; these errors therefore should not be compared directly with the full-window averages in the other ablations. paragraphs.en: DreamHMR adapts video generation representations for complete body-and-hand recovery under occlusion. Complete human renderings transfer surface correspondence and posed geometry into the backbone, while evidence-gated local features refine contextual body-part estimates. paragraphs.en: The part and joint query branches each use two attention layers with eight heads, a 512-D hidden space, and a 2048-D feed-forward network. A two-layer MLP encodes box geometry, confidence, and tracking status at the corresponding endpoints. Each joint descriptor predicts a 2D location in normalized canvas coordinates. Local sampling retrieves a 3 × 3 3\times 3 neighborhood with offsets of one backbone feature cell, averages valid bilinear samples, and returns zero when the center or all samples are invalid. Valid samples lie within the observation region and the feature grid. The evidence head is a → → 1 1024\!\rightarrow\!256\!\rightarrow\!1 MLP with GELU and a final sigmoid. Its score weights the local correction before joint-to-part fusion.
paragraphs.zh: 部件查询分支和关节查询分支各自使用两个注意力层（八个头）、一个 512 维隐藏空间和一个 2048 维前馈网络。 一个双层 MLP 在相应的端点处对框几何形状、置信度和跟踪状态进行编码。 每个关节描述符预测归一化画布坐标中的一个二维位置。 局部采样获取一个 3 × 3 的邻域，其偏移量为一个骨干特征单元；对有效的双线性样本取平均，并在中心或所有样本无效时返回零。 有效样本位于观察区域和特征网格内。 证据头是一个 → → 1 1024\!\rightarrow\!256\!\rightarrow\!1 的 MLP，包含 GELU 激活函数和最终的 sigmoid 函数。 其得分在关节到部件融合之前对局部修正进行加权。

paragraphs.en: All compared methods receive the same observed RGB and target tracks. Video methods process complete windows; image methods process per-frame crops from the shared tracks. We use released inference models without test-time flipping or additional temporal smoothing. SMPLest-X uses the official H40 weights, and 3DB-DINOv3 includes its released hand decoder. Public body evaluation uses 14/24/24 joints for 3DPW/EMDB-1/RICH, respectively, with common joint regressors and frozen topology mappings for SMPL-X, MHR, and SMPL-X/MANO predictions. MPJPE and PVE use pelvis alignment; PA-MPJPE additionally fits a similarity transform. Under occlusion, body MPJPE uses 21 non-root joints relative to the pelvis; hand MPJPE uses 15 joints per hand relative to the wrist, with equal left/right weighting.

paragraphs.en: Video generation pretraining provides a useful initialization for reconstruction under a fixed task-training budget. Table 9 compares pretrained and randomly initialized DiTs within the same Wan architecture after 10,000 task-training steps, with all 81 frames evaluated. The paired runs share task data, the structured readout, evidence gating, and optimization settings; the corresponding pretrained VAE and text encoder are retained in both runs. Pretrained initialization reduces body/hand MPJPE under occlusion by 13.53/8.28 mm at 1.3B and 15.35/12.97 mm at 5B.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成预训练在固定任务训练预算下，为重建过程提供了有效的初始化。 表 9 比较了在相同 Wan 架构下、经过 10,000 步任务训练后，预训练 DiT 与随机初始化的 DiT 的性能，并对全部 81 帧进行了评估。 这两组实验共享任务数据、结构化读出机制、证据门控和优化设置；相应的预训练 VAE 和文本编码器在两组实验中均被保留。 预训练初始化在遮挡情况下，将身体/手部的 MPJPE 在 1.3B 模型上降低了 13.53/8.28 毫米，在 5B 模型上降低了 15.35/12.97 毫米。

paragraphs.en: Evidence gating improves reconstruction under both observation patterns (Table 10 ). On the Wan-1.3B ablation holdout, it reduces body MPJPE by 12.2 mm with static regions and 9.0 mm with dynamic regions. Hand MPJPE improves by 1.6 and 3.8 mm, respectively. These results complement the pooled ablations by showing the benefit of weighting local updates when the observation region is fixed or moves across the person.
paragraphs.zh: 证据门控在两种观察模式下都能提升重建效果（表 10）。 在 Wan-1.3B 消融验证集上，它在静态区域将身体 MPJPE 降低了 12.2 毫米，在动态区域降低了 9.0 毫米。 手部 MPJPE 分别降低了 1.6 毫米和 3.8 毫米。 这些结果补充了合并消融实验，表明当观察区域固定或跨个体移动时，对局部更新进行加权会带来益处。
